El excedente del consumidor es lo que lo: Consumer surplus is what buyers would be willing to pay above what they actually pay: the area between demand and the price. Producer surplus is what sellers receive above the minimum they would accept: the area between the price and supply. Their sum, total surplus, is at its maximum at the competitive equilibrium.
Un impuesto de $t$ por unidad separa el: A tax of $t$ per unit separates the price buyers pay from the price sellers receive: $P_c − P_v = t$. Less is sold, the government collects $t · Q_t$ and the trades between $Q_t$ and $Q^*$ are lost. The share borne by each side does not depend on who is charged: with linear curves, consumers pay the fraction $d/(b + d)$, so the less elastic side bears more.
Un precio máximo por debajo del equilibr: A price ceiling below equilibrium or a price floor above it reduces the quantity traded to that of the short side of the market. Surplus moves from one side to the other, but the total falls: the deadweight loss is the triangle between the curves that is no longer traded.
